title: Rape of US tourist: Karnataka HC stays case against Coorg homestay owner booked for not reporting offence
description: The Karnataka High Court on Tuesday stayed criminal proceedings against the Coorg homestay owner booked under the repealed Foreigners Act of 1946 after an employer at the homestay raped a 33-year-old US tourist.Justice M Nagaprasanna stayed criminal proceedings on the basis that the offences alleged to have been committed by the homestay owner were under a repealed statute.Further, the Court said the charge under Section 239 (intentional omission to give information of offence to authorities) of
